# Duel audio recordings

All twelve runtime recordings are edited from CC0 sources. The mono gameplay cues play at their world positions. The stereo field recordings loop around the listener. Times below are seconds into the original files.

| Runtime cue | Original recording and edit | Credit and source |
|---|---|---|
| Draw, Nock, Release, Flight | English Longbow Draw (2.66–4.02), English Longbow Nock Arrow (3.53–3.91), English Longbow Shoot (0.08–0.38), Scythian Recurve Arrow Passby (0.65–1.04) | [Ben Jaszczak and Brian Nelson, Medieval sound effects](https://opengameart.org/content/medieval-sound-effects-weapon-textures) |
| Body, Stone, Wood | qubodupImpactMeat02, qubodupImpactStone, qubodupImpactWood | [Iwan “qubodup” Gabovitch, Impact](https://opengameart.org/content/impact) |
| Ground | boots-leather-step-02, trimmed to a dull contact | [Vehicle, Fantasy Weapons and Apparel](https://opengameart.org/content/fantasy-weapons-and-apparel-sfx-library) |
| Breath | breathing tired, looped and pitched down during playback | [mikeask, Breathing tired](https://opengameart.org/content/breathing-tired) |
| WoodlandRange | Forest_Ambience, 2–27 | [TinyWorlds, Forest Ambience](https://opengameart.org/content/forest-ambience) |
| CastleCourtyard, VillageYard | park_ambience_wind (15–40), park_ambience_birds (14–39) | [Thimras, Park ambiences](https://opengameart.org/content/park-ambiences) |

The runtime edits use 32 kHz Vorbis with trimmed transients and crossfaded loop boundaries. [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)
